outcome: maternal and fetal complications (HELLP syndrome, pathological symptom, IUGR)
cohort: The study included 30 women with preeclampsia and 30 women with normal pregnancy.
finding: Decreased maternal serum DKK1 levels were associated with worse maternal and fetal complications, and placental mRNA DKK1 levels were lower in preeclamptic women compared with normal pregnant women at delivery.
